subject: Intro: Redwood demo + security intake for NovaForge
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martín <elena.martin@novaforge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo + security intake for NovaForge

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the intro and interest in Redwood. I’m Aditya (AE) — looping in Soojin from solutions engineering so we can coordinate the technical intake. Can you confirm who from NovaForge will be the champion for this project and the engineering lead we should invite? We typically run a 45–60 minute initial discovery to cover use cases, security constraints, and next-step success criteria.

Quick ask so we can get a calendar on the books: do any of the following windows work for your team next week (PT)?
- Wed 8/26 — 9:30–10:30am or 3:00–4:00pm PT
- Thu 8/27 — 11:00–12:00pm PT

If procurement/security need to join for intake (SOC 2 questions, data residency), please cc them — we can keep the first 20 minutes high level then transition to a security-focused queue. I’ve attached a short intro deck and an M.A.P. template to speed approvals.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments:
- redwood-intro-slide.pdf (6 slides)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft)

From: Elena Martín <elena.martin@novaforge.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Kim <dan.kim@novaforge.com>, procurement@novaforge.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo + security intake for NovaForge

Hi Aditya —

Thanks, and great to meet you. I’ll be the program champion. I’ve copied our engineering lead, Daniel, and our procurement inbox so they get looped in.

For next week the team is a little tight. Daniel is available:
- Thu 8/27 — 11:00–11:45am PT (tight but doable)
- Fri 8/28 — 8:30–9:30am PT

Procurement is likely to sit in on the security portion — they prefer short sessions and an explicit list of requested artifacts (SOC 2, data retention policy, network diagram). Can Soojin confirm what we should prepare so procurement doesn’t need a long follow-up?

Thanks,
Elena
VP, Product Operations — NovaForge
elena.martin@novaforge.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martín <elena.martin@novaforge.com>, Daniel Kim <dan.kim@novaforge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo + security intake for NovaForge

Thanks Elena — perfect, appreciate the quick coordination. Thu 8/27 11:00am PT works for us (I’ll tentatively block 60 minutes to ensure we have time for an engineering deep-dive and a short procurement/security walkthrough).

Sooj, Marissa — can you both make 8/27 11:00am PT?

Elena / Daniel — for procurement/security prep, we typically surface the following artifacts in the intake: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), architecture diagram (high level), data retention policy, and an outline of request routing & encryption at rest/in transit. I’m attaching a short SOC2 summary; Sooj will add any further items.

If procurement would prefer to only join the last 15–20 minutes, we can structure the agenda accordingly — first 30–40 minutes for use-case & engineering questions, then a 20-minute security/procurement slot.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite once we confirm attendees.

Best,
Aditya

Attachments referenced:
- soc2-summary.pdf (1 page summary)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martín <elena.martin@novaforge.com>, Daniel Kim <dan.kim@novaforge.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo + security intake for NovaForge

Hi all —

Thanks — I can join Thu 8/27 at 11:00am PT. A couple of short notes from the SE side to make the session productive:
- We’ll aim for a 60-minute slot: 35–40 minutes technical discovery (latency/cost/throughput goals, sample prompt patterns, data flows) + 20 minutes security/procurement Q&A.
- Please have a short example prompt or a representative query volume estimate handy (tokens/session, sessions/day).
- Security checklist (recommended artifacts to attach ahead of time): SOC 2 summary, network diagram (redacted), expected data classification (PII/PHI/no-PII), and whether you plan to use private deployment vs hosted API.

I’ve sketched a tentative agenda and attached it as a one-pager. Also, Marissa from our Solutions Eng team will join for the engineering deep-dive.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai

Attachment:
- redwood-demo-intake-agenda.pdf (1 page)

From: Daniel Kim <dan.kim@novaforge.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Elena Martín <elena.martin@novaforge.com>
Cc: procurement@novaforge.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 08:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo + security intake for NovaForge

On Thu, Aug 26, 2026 at 08:43 -0700 Soojin Lee wrote:
> Hi all —
> 
> Thanks — I can join Thu 8/27 at 11:00am PT. A couple of short notes from the SE side to make the session productive:
> - We’ll aim for a 60-minute slot: 35–40 minutes technical discovery (latency/cost/throughput goals, sample prompt patterns, data flows) + 20 minutes security/procurement Q&A.

Thanks Soojin — that plan works. I do need to shift the meeting by 1 hour because of an internal standup that just moved to 11am PT. Can we make it 12:00–1:00pm PT instead? Procurement will still join for the last 20 minutes.

If that’s okay I’ll confirm and accept the invite.

—Daniel
Engineering Lead, NovaForge
dan.kim@novaforge.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <dan.kim@novaforge.com>, Elena Martín <elena.martin@novaforge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, procurement@novaforge.com
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo + security intake for NovaForge

Hi Daniel — that’s no problem, 12:00–1:00pm PT works for the Redwood side. I’ve updated the calendar invite and set the meeting length to 60 minutes with the last 20 minutes marked as "security/procurement".

Agenda (final):
1) 12:00–12:10 — Introductions & success criteria (Aditya / Elena)
2) 12:10–12:40 — Technical discovery (Soojin / Marissa)
3) 12:40–1:00 — Security & procurement Q&A (Aditya / Soojin)

Attachments added to the event: redwood-intro-slide.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456 (invite sent)

If anyone needs to edit attendees (e.g., add a network security architect) let me know and I’ll update the invite. See you Thursday.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
